root_cause: The existing autonomous engineering tuner can propose bounded performance changes but had no measured post-change evaluation or safe reversion for a demonstrated regression; successive tuning decisions could compound unnoticed mistakes.
failureModes: no before/after evidence chain for daily CI tuning
upward tuning without post-change Required and job samples
observable regression leaves deteriorated knobs in canonical tuning configuration
prevention: persist previous tuning and exact observed baseline in existing canonical config
measure actual post-change GitHub job and Required timing samples, not all historical jobs
require 30-hour minimum observation horizon, 20 post-change jobs, 5 Required runs, 10 queue samples
close with observational no-regression evidence or safely revert prior knobs through existing protected tuning PR
never claim causality, revenue effect or improved speed without verified outcome

evaluation.baseline_comparison: Prior optimizer only enforced a 30-hour upward cooldown, without comparing post-change job and Required p95 against the saved baseline.
evaluation.success_metric: Measured before/after CI p95 and job failure rate with eligibility counts and automatic rollback on observed regression.
evaluation.limitations: Comparing time windows is observational and may be confounded by workload, provider pressure or unrelated changes.
evaluation.rollback: protected revert if the new tracker itself causes CI failure, or the tuning experiment restores its saved previous bounded values
